newsitem.title: JAPAN: Showa Line to sell sole cruise ship.
newsitem.headline: Showa Line to sell sole cruise ship.

text.p: Showa Line Ltd, one of Japan's major ship operators, said on Monday that it had decided to sell its only cruiser, the Oceanic Grace, and to withdraw from the cruise liner business as of June 1.
A spokesman said the trend toward larger ships travelling greater distances spurred the move to idle the vessel.
"Customers now appear to want to take cruises on bigger ships," he said.

The 5,218-tonne ship, with 60 rooms and the capacity to carry 120 passengers, was launched in 1989 and carried 12,000 to 15,000 passengers a year, mostly to ports in Japan and neighbouring countries, he said.
Although the ship was capable of longer trips, its small size made it more suited to short excursions, he said.
